02 — Projects

Selected work(03)

01Simulation Game

CSSim

Computer Systems Servicing Simulation Game. Focuses on PC troubleshooting, hardware assembly, and computer servicing.

  • Unity 6.3
  • C#
  • Git LFS
GitHub

CSSim puts the player in the role of a computer technician. Players diagnose and troubleshoot PCs, assemble hardware, and work through hands-on servicing tasks in a game format, such as arranging T568B network cable wiring, punching down a patch panel, and configuring a server and router.

Interface roadmap

The interface was planned in a Sprint 1 UI roadmap: global and system UI, main menu, job and shop UI, assembly, BIOS, Windows and completion screens, task frameworks, business HUD, final assessment UI, then polish and QA.

02Educational Arcade Game

BotBlitz Dash

An educational arcade game centered around electronic waste awareness, with colorful visuals and fast gameplay.

  • Unity
  • GitHub
  • Computer hardware
GitHub

BotBlitz Dash is an arcade-style game that teaches players about electronic waste while they play. It also teaches how a computer unit is assembled, so players pick up electronic waste awareness and basic computer hardware knowledge through fast, colorful gameplay.

03Cooking Game

SANGKAP

A Filipino cuisine-inspired cooking game that highlights Filipino culture, cooking mechanics, and pixel art.

  • Pixel art
  • Unity
  • Unity Version Control
GitHub

SANGKAP lets players cook Filipino dishes in a pixel art world. The recipes come from across the regions of the Philippines, so players learn the dishes while they cook.
